limitations: fixtures are authored containers, not camera captures: a CRW here carries CIFF components and no raw image data, BMP/GIF/TGA carry their header and no pixel payload, and the five container stubs carry only the bytes their reader tests, so a refusal is not evidence that a format is unsupported and a success is not evidence of metadata support; no MetadataSharp code is exercised; no B11 write suboperation is attempted, so the symmetric CRW encoder is neither claimed nor refuted; no video metadata family is enumerated because the pinned table claims none; ExifTool is a secondary reference, not an oracle.
